title: Universal embeddings obtained by transposing finite free quotients
statement: Let X be any scheme, M a finite locally free O_X-module, r a natural number, and beta: O_X^r -> dual M an epimorphism. Define alpha: M -> O_X^r by composing the biduality map of M, the transpose of beta, and the finite-free dual isomorphism. Then alpha is monic, its categorical cokernel is finite locally free, and g^*alpha is monic for every scheme morphism g:Y -> X.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), transpose of the dual-surjection construction; local splitting, finite locally free cokernel and arbitrary pullback

proof.text: Apply exists_local_retraction_dualMap_of_epi to beta; its target dual M is finite locally free. Restrict the bidual isomorphism and homObjFreeUnitIso along the resulting opens. Composing these split monomorphisms with the local split transpose gives a locally split alpha. A morphism monic on an open cover is monic (mono_of_restrict).

For a split inclusion f:A -> B of finite locally free sheaves, its split cokernel sequence remains split after affine evaluation. Thus the sections of cokernel f are a retract of the finite projective sections of B. They are finite projective, hence finitely presented and flat; isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isAffineOpen proves finite local freeness. Restriction preserves cokernels. Apply this argument to each local splitting of alpha and glue finite local freeness with isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isOpenImmersion. All these arguments are proved in the private helpers of this module.

For each g:Y -> X take the inverse images of the local splitting opens. The pullback-composition and restriction-to-pullback natural isomorphisms identify the restricted pulled-back alpha with pullback of the original restricted alpha. Pulling back its retraction preserves its identity. Conjugate by these natural isomorphisms to obtain a local retraction. The inverse-image opens cover Y, so mono_of_restrict gives monicity of pullback alpha. This transport and the cover calculation are proved in mono_pullback_of_locallySplitMono.

lean.statement:
theorem dual_free_quotient_embedding
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    {r : ℕ} (β : free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ⟶ dual M) [Epi β] :
    let α := SheafOfModules.bidual (R := X.sheaf) M ≫ dualMap β ≫
      (SheafOfModules.homObjFreeUnitIso (R := X.sheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))).hom
    Mono α ∧ (cokernel α).IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X), Mono ((Modules.pullback g).map α)
